metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Outer Leg Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to instantly relieve outer leg pain. 

A main cause of outer hip, thigh, and leg pain is due to a blend of weakness in the muscles that help support this area. These muscles include the glutes (buttocks), tensor fasciae latae (TFL), and quadratus lumborum (QL). 

These exercises will focus on stretching and strengthening, that way be can get both quick and long-lasting pain relief.

Each exercise works differently, they're going to target different muscles. To get the best result, go through them all and use what gives you the most outer leg pain relief.
